description: Outputs written by the standard NonLinLoc adapter.

files.located_events.csv: Parsed locations when NLLoc is executed
files.loc/: Native NLLoc location products and logs

failure: The adapter exits non-zero, writes status=failed when possible, and emits a JSON error on stderr when a required input, executable, or native stage fails. Existing output directories are not replaced unless --overwrite is supplied.
